verdict.rationale: Devin docs explicitly document running multiple Devins in parallel on independent tasks and provide an API with create_as_user_id for programmatically spawning sessions on behalf of org members, directly supporting concurrent scaling of throughput. However, there's no first-party data on concurrency limits, cost/resource management at scale, or independent case studies validating throughput gains at team scale; missing for 10: quantified concurrency limits/scaling guidance, independent evidence of large-scale parallel usage, and cost/governance controls for many simultaneous sessions.
